from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyInterestExpense(BaseModel):
    """Interest expense reported for one company in its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company's name as it appears in the document")
    interest_expense_amount: float | None = Field(description="The interest expense amount as a numeric value")
    interest_expense_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the report, e.g. '利息费用', '利息支出'")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元', '万元', '百万元'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this figure, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt from the document containing the interest expense value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_interest_expenses: list[CompanyInterestExpense]
